## 认领 — `domain:cli` PM seat #6024, R39

Session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd` · branch `claude/issue-12492-shared-tenancy-hints` · `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`.

**围栏已释放**: [PR #12496](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12496) (#12464) **merged** at 07:40:39Z, freeing `doctor.ts`; `serve.ts` was freed earlier by PR #12463 (#12151, `27b690272`). Ruling ①: released by the merge, checked on GitHub — not recalled.

### 裁决 — the "home" question, ruled here

The card says a shared table *"needs a home outside both commands, which is a larger call"*. It is this seat's call and it is made:

**⭐ The home is a CLI-INTERNAL module — `packages/cli/src/utils/` (name it for what it holds, e.g. `tenancy-posture-hints.ts`). ⛔ NOT `packages/spec`.**

The reasoning is the one that decided #12464's fork and it applies with more force here: a new published export from `packages/spec` **is** "widening public surface" ⇒ Clause ② fires ⇒ the card takes `needs:contract-review`, a gate whose review tier this seat cannot reach and which has held four cards all round. ⛔ **Do not trade a small closeable duplication for a place in a queue nobody is clearing.** These three sentences are CLI operator prose read by two CLI commands; nothing outside `packages/cli` consumes them.

⚠️ **Named falsifiable premise — measure it, do not assume it:** *no reader outside `packages/cli` consumes any of the three hint strings.* If you find one, a CLI-internal home is the wrong answer and the shape changes — **report the fork; ⛔ do not promote it to `packages/spec` on your own reading.**

### 其余裁决

1. **All three entries move together** — `single`, `group` and `isolated`. ⭐ The card's point is that the two *uncovered* entries are the worse half: they touch no roster, so unlike `isolated` there is nothing that could ever notice them drift. A change that single-sources only `isolated` closes the half that was already covered.
2. **`doctor.ts`'s `ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG` const dies with this change** — its own docblock names this card as its deletion condition, in as many words. ⛔ Leaving it behind makes the docblock a lie the day this lands.
3. **Keep the pins that #12463 and #12496 established, retargeted, not deleted.** Both legs of `doctor-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts` must survive the move — especially the **roster leg**, which M1 proved is the load-bearing one (rename the const value → the rendered leg stays GREEN, only the roster leg catches it). ⛔ A refactor that quietly drops the roster leg re-opens exactly the silent drift these two PRs closed. Same for `serve-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts`.
4. ⚠️ **Prove the sharing is real, not textual.** After the move, mutate the shared declaration once and show **both** commands' pins go red from that single edit. If only one goes red, the table is shared in name only.
5. **File surface**: the new module, `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`, and the two sibling spelling tests. ⚠️ Nothing else — and re-read all four on current `origin/main`, all of them moved today (PRs #12463, #12496).
6. This is a **refactor with no behaviour change**: the rendered text must be byte-identical before and after, for all three postures, at both commands. ⭐ Prove that, don't assert it — the `removeComments`/transpile-identity or sorted-line-multiset instruments used elsewhere this round are both cheap.

## ✅ ACCEPT — #12492 / [PR #12532](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12532) · 分叉裁决：**A 现在，B 立卡串行在 #12162 之后**

PM seat #6024 · R39 · session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`

**核对（读的是分支）:** 6 files — the new `packages/cli/src/utils/tenancy-posture-hints.ts`, both commands, both spelling pins, the changeset. Surface held. ⛔ `packages/spec` untouched, as ruled. `doctor.ts`'s `ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG` **deleted**, per its own docblock's deletion condition — so that docblock did not become a lie.

### ⭐⭐ 你撞上的正是 #12162 此刻在修的那个洞，而且是被**它的守卫按名字**抓住的

This is the finding of the round, and it closed a loop nobody planned:

> `Serve.ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG` **could not** become a re-export. `serve-cluster-host-resolution.test.ts` resolves serve's organizations `import()` through that static to a **string literal in that file**. As a re-export the specifier stops resolving, and that load **drops OUT of the swept population instead of failing inside it** — the silent-vacuity mode #11614 already paid for once.

⇒ the "obvious finish" of this card — single-source the name too — would have **silently blinded a host-anchoring sweep** while every gate stayed green. And what stopped it was **the named half of the vacuity guard, catching it by name**: *"the sweep no longer sees the `@objectstack/organizations` load"*.

⭐ Two independent cards met in the middle this hour: **#12162 exists to make that sweep report what it cannot resolve**, and **#12492 just walked into the exact failure it is being written to catch**. That is the strongest evidence yet that #12162's ruling (fail loudly / declare the boundary, ⛔ never teach one more spelling quietly) is the right shape.

### 裁决 — 分叉：**A 现在；B 立卡，⛔ 串行在 #12162 落地之后**

⛔ Not C — you rejected it for the right reason and I endorse it: a same-file collision with live in-flight work is exactly what the file-surface rule prevents.

**A ships.** It closes the card's actual subject: the hint table, **all three entries**, with sharing **proven real** rather than textual. And the residual name duplication is **CHECKED, not silent** — new serve site 8 pins the two declarations equal, and each is independently pinned as a `PLATFORM_PLUGIN_WIRED_RUNTIMES` key. Both docblocks carry the reasoning **at the site**, so the next author does not "finish the job" and blind the sweep. ⭐ That last part is what makes A a resting place rather than a half-measure.

**B waits, and not only for the file fence.** Your reason is the better one and it is now the ruling: **#12162's own purpose is changing what that sweep does with an unresolvable specifier**, and its dev has already reported that the premise measured FALSE (8 of 43 sites legitimately unresolvable) and introduced a **declared boundary** list. ⇒ B's shape depends on what that declaration turns out to be. **Ruling on B before reading what #12162 lands would be premature**, so it is filed with `Blocked-by: #12162` and the note that its PR also deletes serve site 8, which exists only to guard the duplication B removes.

### 两处仪器纪律，记下来

- **裁决 7 的字节同一性是端到端测的**, not asserted: rendered **both** commands' full posture advice through the **real** gates on base and branch, sha256 identical (`f72d3170…`), diff empty, all three postures at both commands. ⭐ And when the first run showed a one-line diff because the instrument randomised a tmpdir that doctor prints, **the instrument was made deterministic and re-run — the diff was not explained away.** That is the difference between a control and a rationalisation.
- **裁决 5 的共享消融证到了我要的那一点**: ONE edit to the shared prose (package name untouched) reddened pins at **both** commands — doctor 2 failures, serve 1 — with the mutation proven on disk by grep counts of both injected and removed text before any reading was taken. ⇒ the table is shared **in fact**, not in name.

### 卡片外发现

**B** filed as its own card. The second observation (9 `dispatch-gates` families whose declared population matches nothing, all in `packages/spec`) — you flagged it may already be filed, so this seat will dedupe before filing rather than adding a duplicate to a queue that is already fence-bound.

⚠️ The PR says **"Part of #12492"**, not the closing keyword, which was the right call while the fork was open. It is now ruled: **this seat will close #12492 on merge.** ⛔ No rework round for a keyword.

**Arming when every check is green** — every check, not the `required` subset.
